column3: First I picked the colors I liked the most, then I figured out what colors my partner liked, which were very similar and found out which colors she picked over other ones, and picked those. We kept on going and continued this pattern, and I kept on realizing which colors she liked more and picked those.

I think we quickly established that we would always click pink and never click yellow. to establish the rest I tried to keep track of if my partner consistently clicked one color over another and then tried to match that. If there was something I felt we were both inconsistent on I tried to choose one myself and stick with it until they got the hint.
